upload_instructions: Set the MIDI Inter-packet delay to 30 ms.
Hold FUNCTION during power-on and select TRIG 5 (MIDI UPGRADE).
Click 'Upload MIDI Upgrade File' below and pick the .syx file.
receive_instructions: Hold FUNCTION during power-on and select TRIG 6 (SEND UPGRADE).

bank_select_reset.description: Sent alongside Panic to reset bank selects.

sample_name_tag.description: Contains the ASCII name of a sample. Cannot be requested directly. Only sent by the MD immediately after an SDS Header (`0x01`) during a sample transfer.

identity_inquiry.description: Standard Universal Device Inquiry. Request: `F0 7E 7F 06 01 F7`. Response: `F0 7E [dev] 06 02 [manuf] [family] [model] [version] F7`.

sequencer_modes.description: Sets the sequencer to Classic mode (32 steps) or Extended mode (64 steps + param locks).

local_control_toggle.description: Enables or disables the physical controls. When Off, the front panel does not trigger the internal sound engine directly.

note_trigger.note: Factory default bank A notes from the `keymap` global field. The device plays the pattern once when a note is sent.

load_kit.note: Anything above 63 loads the UNDO KIT instead of a flash slot.

status.note: Sending `query_cmd` with no sub-byte is a bare presence ping. The device answers with `reply_cmd` and no parameter.

write_arm.description: Arms the device to receive a kit/pattern/song dump. Payload: `[write_arm.cmd, write_arm_type, slot, 0x01]`. `write_arm_type` is per-kind, see `sysex_api.{kit,pattern,song}.write_arm_type`.

tonal.note: Only some machines support tonal tuning.

state.note: Internal LFO oscillator state. Byte-level meaning not reverse-engineered.

sysex.description: LFO configurations are sent as a continuous block. Param ID is calculated by track offset.
